stem.text: Determine whether the series \( \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n \), where \( a_n = \frac{n^{1}}{4^{n}} \), converges or diverges. Name a test whose conditions the series meets and state the verdict it gives.

answer_key.label: The series converges by the ratio test, because \( \lim_{n\to\infty} \left|\frac{a_{n+1}}{a_n}\right| = \frac{1}{4} < 1 \).

worked_solution.text: The general term \( \frac{n^{1}}{4^{n}} \) has an exponential in the denominator, so the ratio test fits.
